sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travel to Telford Town on Saturday 7 November looking to bounce back from consecutive defeats. Despite their recent loss-loss sequence, Sandbach remain 1st in the table with 31 points from 15 games, and face struggling Telford Town (7 points, on a poor run) in what should offer an opportunity to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (29 points) host AFC Bridgnorth in a top-five clash, with both sides among the division's best performers. Eccleshall, third with 28 points, travel to New Mills seeking to maintain their excellent form after a recent draw. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 28 points and fourth, face Foley Meir at home. Bilston Town, sixth with 26 points, host struggling Cheadle Heath Nomads. Barnton (25 points, 7th) are at home to fellow mid-table side Market Drayton Town. Allscott Heath entertain Wednesfield Community in a match between sides in the lower-middle section. Brereton Social face Shawbury United in a fixture between two struggling teams. Crewe host Dawley Town in a mid-table encounter. At the bottom, Alsager Town travel to face struggling Widnes Town (6 points) in a battle of the division's weakest sides.
